# Open Source Apps

Open Source Apps is a curated directory of real open-source applications that developers can run, study, and contribute to.

The project focuses on complete applications, not SDKs, templates, toy demos, or abandoned README lists.

Main URL: https://open-apps.dev.mn/
GitHub: https://github.com/tortuvshin/open-apps

## Current scope

The directory currently starts with Flutter apps and is expanding into React Native, native iOS, native Android, Kotlin Multiplatform, Capacitor, desktop, and web apps.

## Important pages

- Home: https://open-apps.dev.mn/
- About: https://open-apps.dev.mn/about
- Apps: https://open-apps.dev.mn/apps
- Hot apps: https://open-apps.dev.mn/apps?label=hot
- New apps: https://open-apps.dev.mn/apps?label=new
- Mature apps: https://open-apps.dev.mn/apps?label=mature
- Browse by stack: https://open-apps.dev.mn/apps
- Browse by category: https://open-apps.dev.mn/apps

## What the site contains

- Real open-source applications
- App categories
- Technology stacks
- Platform support
- License information
- GitHub stars
- Repository activity
- Maturity signals
- Contribution links
